name: Correlation
description: Pairwise correlation of two or more numeric columns in long format, one row per pair. Pearson uses the raw values, Spearman correlates ranks.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: At least two distinct numeric columns; every unordered pair is emitted.

method.title: Method
method.description: pearson correlates raw values, spearman correlates ranks with ties sharing a rank.
